primary_claim: Across six WMDP-Bio-unlearned Llama-3-8B-Instruct checkpoints (RMU, ILU-RMU, NPO, GradDiff, NPO-ILU, IDK-AP), forget-set representation-targeted direction ablation and unrelated fine-tuning on GSM8K each recover substantial WMDP-Bio accuracy for several methods (up to 64% gap recovered and +41.4 accuracy points respectively), while refusal-direction ablation recovers no knowledge in the one checkpoint (ILU-RMU) where a clean refusal direction could be extracted, and qualitative inspection shows only 40-47% of 'recovered' answers reflect genuinely correct reasoning rather than contradictory or degenerate generations, showing that WMDP forced-choice accuracy alone overstates genuine knowledge recovery.

effect.metric: WMDP-Bio forced-choice accuracy recovery via different probes
effect.value: forget-set representation ablation: 57-64% gap recovered for RMU/ILU-RMU/NPO, 19% for IDK-AP; unrelated GSM8K fine-tuning: +41.4pp (RMU), +23.8pp (ILU-RMU), +22.5pp (NPO) with MMLU flat; refusal-direction ablation: no recovery (95% CI excluded improvements >1.4pp) in ILU-RMU; only 40-47% of recovered answers showed genuine correct reasoning on qualitative review

contradicts_or_qualifies: Replicates and extends Arditi & Chughtai's finding that forget-set representation-direction ablation recovers knowledge from RMU-unlearned models, extending it from Zephyr-7B to Llama-3-8B-Instruct and to additional unlearning methods (NPO, IDK-AP)

For ILU-RMU, where a clean refusal direction could be isolated, refusal ablation did not recover knowledge, suggesting refusal is not the primary suppression mechanism there, contrary to a plausible general hypothesis that unlearning-induced refusal masks retained knowledge
stated_future_work: Repeat the experiments on larger models and different model families to test generalization
Test unrelated fine-tuning recovery with data sources other than GSM8K to see if recovery depends on data type
Test additional localization and recovery methods beyond the three probes used
Conduct a systematic, larger-sample qualitative evaluation to better characterize the relationship between benchmark recovery and actual reasoning recovery
limitations_stated: Experiments were done only on six Llama-3-8B-Instruct checkpoints; unclear whether findings generalize to larger models or other model families
Only GSM8K was tested for the unrelated-SFT probe; recovery may depend on the type of fine-tuning data used
Only three recovery methods were tested; other localization/recovery methods could reveal more
Qualitative evaluation of generation quality was done on small samples
quote: A clean refusal direction was obtained only from the ILU-RMU checkpoint, reducing the refusal rate from 98% to 0% when ablated.
